description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Returns the oldest open task from the studio's queue: id, instructions, the sites the task may read, the output format expected, and where to deliver the result. Returns {no_tasks: true} when the queue is empty. login_allowed lists the hosts where the task may sign in, with a credential already in Muse's own store; empty means read-only, never sign in. ALWAYS pass already_submitted: the ids of every task you have submitted a result for in the last 14 days (your own skip list). This server keeps no memory between calls, so that list is the only thing that reliably stops it handing a finished task back to you; with it, each call returns the next task you have not done.

already_submitted.description: Task ids you have already submitted a result for. They are skipped. Send your whole recent skip list on every call.

name: next_task_for_muse

browser.description: cloud: your own browser (the default). chrome: the Chrome on Joe's Mac, Field Agent profile only, for a form behind a granted sign-in or a test of our own pages.
